1.plot: 匹兹堡一家医院的急诊室，一集大约是一个小时的班。主治医生罗比带着实习生处理接连进来的病人，私人的事只能插在两副担架之间。
1.plotEn: The emergency room of a hospital in Pittsburgh. An episode is about an hour of a shift. The attending, Robbie, takes the interns through the patients who keep coming in. Private matters can only be fitted between two stretchers.
1.playbill: 一集大致对应急诊室里一小时的班，整季就是一个 15 小时的班次。不靠恋爱戏撑场，靠快速而真实的抢救流程，以及医护人员的疲惫和创伤。《急诊室的故事》里的诺亚·怀尔担任主演，2025 年拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集和男主角。
1.playbillEn: An episode is roughly one hour of a shift in an emergency room, and the season is one fifteen-hour shift. It does not lean on a romance. It leans on a fast, believable sequence of treatment, and on how tired and damaged the staff are. Noah Wyle, from ER, is the lead. In 2025 it won the Emmys for best drama and lead actor.

2.plot: 马特是一位新上任的电影制片公司负责人，为了获得各路名流的认可，他和大陆影业的执行团队必须在公司利益和创意追求之间寻求平衡，同时还要力图为电影制作注入新的生机和活力，并与时俱进。
2.plotEn: Desperate for celebrity approval, the newly appointed head of a movie studio and his executive team at Continental Studios must juggle corporate demands with creative ambitions as they try to keep movies alive and relevant.

3.plot: 1600 年的日本，英国水手布莱克索恩的船漂到岸上，正赶上大名之间决定谁来统治的前夜。翻译真理夫人把两套语言、两套忠诚都扛在身上。
3.plotEn: In Japan in 1600, the English sailor Blackthorne’s ship drifts ashore on the eve of the lords deciding who will rule. Lady Mariko, the translator, carries both languages and both loyalties.
3.playbill: 1600 年的日本，战国末期，一名英国领航员漂流上岸，卷入大名之间的权力斗争。台词大部分是日语，服装、礼仪和政治博弈都很讲究。真田广之主演兼任制片，第一季拿下创纪录的 18 项艾美奖。
3.playbillEn: Japan in 1600, at the end of the warring states. An English navigator washes ashore and is pulled into the struggle among the lords. Most of the dialogue is in Japanese. The costume, the etiquette, and the political maneuvering are all careful. Hiroyuki Sanada stars and produces. The first season won a record 18 Emmys.

4.plot: 拉斯维加斯老牌笑匠黛博拉·万斯事业下滑，被迫和被行业赶走的年轻写手艾娃合作。两个人互相看不起，又都需要对方的句子。
4.plotEn: Deborah Vance, a long-running comic in Las Vegas, is slipping, and is forced to work with Ava, a young writer the industry has pushed out. They look down on each other, and each of them needs the other’s sentences.
4.playbill: 拉斯维加斯的老牌女笑星，和一个被行业封杀的年轻写手合作写段子。两人一开始互相看不上，后来成了最懂彼此的人。珍·斯玛特凭此多次拿下艾美喜剧类女主角，第三季还获得最佳喜剧剧集。
4.playbillEn: An established woman comic in Las Vegas writes material with a young writer the industry has blacklisted. They cannot stand each other at first, and later become the people who understand each other best. Jean Smart has won the Emmy for lead actress in a comedy more than once for it, and the third season also won best comedy series.

5.plot: 媒体巨头洛根·罗伊中风之后，四个子女开始计算谁能接过公司。他们有钱、有伤害，也有一句永远说不出口的话：父亲并不打算交给任何人。
5.plotEn: After the media magnate Logan Roy has a stroke, his four children start calculating who can take the company. They have money and they have injuries, and they have a sentence they can never say: their father does not intend to give it to anyone.
5.playbill: 媒体帝国的父亲和四个子女争继承权，很像现代版《李尔王》。台词刻薄又好笑，几乎每个人都很糟，但都很好看。四季结构完整、结局干脆，三次拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集。
5.playbillEn: A media empire’s father and his four children fight over the succession. It is a lot like a modern King Lear. The dialogue is cruel and funny. Almost everyone is awful, and good to watch. Four seasons, a complete shape, a clean ending. It won the Emmy for best drama three times.

6.plot: 名厨卡米回到芝加哥，接管哥哥自杀后留下的牛肉三明治店。厨房又吵又挤，他想把它做成一家真正的餐厅，家人却还停在丧事里。
6.plotEn: The chef Carmy comes back to Chicago to take over the beef-sandwich shop his brother left when he killed himself. The kitchen is loud and cramped. He wants to make it a real restaurant. The family is still inside the funeral.
6.playbill: 顶级厨师回到芝加哥，接手已故哥哥留下的三明治店。厨房戏非常紧张，镜头和对白像在打仗。第一季第七集一镜到底；第二季的《鱼》是一场全家圣诞晚餐的灾难现场。
6.playbillEn: A top chef comes back to Chicago to take over the sandwich shop his late brother left. The kitchen scenes are extremely tense. The camera and the dialogue feel like a fight. Episode seven of the first season is a single take. “Fishes,” in the second season, is a family Christmas dinner going to pieces.

7.plot: 吉米·麦吉尔是个滑头律师，哥哥查克看不起他，女友金姆比他更清楚界线在哪。为了成为索尔·古德曼，他把自己一点点改名、改行、改掉。
7.plotEn: Jimmy McGill is a slippery lawyer. His brother Chuck looks down on him, and his girlfriend Kim knows where the line is better than he does. To become Saul Goodman he renames himself, changes his trade, and changes himself, a piece at a time.
7.playbill: 《绝命毒师》的前传，讲吉米怎样变成索尔·古德曼。节奏比原作慢，人物更细腻，瑞亚·西霍恩演的金是全剧最好的角色之一。没看过《绝命毒师》也能看，看过会更痛。
7.playbillEn: A prequel to Breaking Bad, about how Jimmy becomes Saul Goodman. It is slower than the original, and the people are drawn more finely. Rhea Seehorn’s Kim is one of the best roles in the show. You can watch it without Breaking Bad. If you have seen Breaking Bad, it hurts more.

8.plot: 一群敬业、热情的老师和一位略显失聪的校长聚集在费城的一所公立学校，决心帮助学生在生活中取得成功。
8.plotEn: In this workplace comedy, a group of dedicated, passionate teachers — and a slightly tone-deaf principal — are brought together in a Philadelphia public school where, despite the odds stacked against them, they are determined to help their students succeed in life. Though these incredible public servants may be outnumbered and underfunded, they love what they do — even if they don’t love the school district’s less-than-stellar attitude toward educating children.

10.plot: 美国橄榄球教练泰德·拉索被雇去执教一支英国足球队，东家原本指望他搞砸。他用饼干和不肯嘲讽人的办法，先改变了更衣室。
10.plotEn: Ted Lasso, an American football coach, is hired to manage an English soccer team. The owner originally expected him to wreck it. He starts by changing the locker room, with biscuits and a refusal to mock people.
10.playbill: 完全不懂足球的美国橄榄球教练，去执教一支英超球队。他乐观到近乎傻，却慢慢感染了身边的人。第一季是最暖的职场喜剧之一，后面几季单集变长，节奏也变散。
10.playbillEn: An American football coach who knows nothing about soccer is hired to manage a Premier League team. He is optimistic to the point of seeming foolish, and slowly infects the people around him. The first season is one of the warmest workplace comedies. Later seasons make the episodes longer, and the pace looser.

11.plot: 从伊丽莎白二世登基写到世纪之交。王室在这里是一户不能辞职的人家，首相、配偶和子女都要跟职位谈判。三位演员接力扮演女王。
11.plotEn: It follows Elizabeth II from her accession to the turn of the century. The royal family here is a household that cannot resign. Prime ministers, spouses, and children all have to negotiate with the office. Three actors take turns as the queen.
11.playbill: 从伊丽莎白二世登基讲到 21 世纪初，每两季换一批演员，跟着人物一起变老。每集多围绕一个历史事件，比如艾伯凡矿难、戴安娜接受 BBC 采访，适合想了解英国现代史的人。前两季的克莱尔·福伊和马特·史密斯最受好评。
11.playbillEn: From Elizabeth II’s accession into the early twenty-first century. Every two seasons the cast changes, and the characters age with it. Episodes are often built around one historical event, such as the Aberfan disaster or Diana’s interview with the BBC. It suits someone who wants modern British history. Claire Foy and Matt Smith, in the first two seasons, are the most praised.

14.plot: 一个在伦敦经营咖啡馆的女人，用对镜头说话来躲开家人、顾客和自己的悲伤。第二季里，她遇到一位同样不该越界的神父。
14.plotEn: A woman running a café in London talks to the camera to get away from her family, her customers, and her own grief. In the second season she meets a priest who is not supposed to cross the line either.
14.playbill: 女主不停对着镜头吐槽，你先被逗笑，后来才发现她在用玩笑躲开悲伤。两季共 12 集，一个下午就能看完。第二季加入安德鲁·斯科特饰演的神父，拿下 2019 年艾美喜剧类最佳剧集、女主角、编剧和导演。
14.playbillEn: The heroine keeps complaining to the camera. You laugh first, and later realize she is using the jokes to stay away from grief. Two seasons, twelve episodes, an afternoon. The second season adds Andrew Scott’s priest. It won the 2019 Emmys for comedy series, lead actress, writing, and directing.

15.plot: 菲利普和伊丽莎白是潜入华盛顿郊区的克格勃特工，对外是旅行社夫妻，对内要执行莫斯科的任务。隔壁邻居正好在联邦调查局工作。
15.plotEn: Philip and Elizabeth are KGB agents planted in the Washington suburbs. In public they are a married couple who run a travel agency. In private they carry out Moscow’s assignments. The neighbor next door happens to work for the FBI.
15.playbill: 冷战时期，一对苏联间谍伪装成美国郊区夫妻，搬来的邻居偏偏是联邦调查局探员。任务戏很紧张，真正好看的是这段假婚姻怎样变成真感情，以及孩子知道真相后会怎样。结局被认为是近年最好的剧集收尾之一。
15.playbillEn: During the Cold War, a pair of Soviet spies pose as a married couple in an American suburb. The neighbor who moves in next door is an FBI agent. The missions are tense. What is really good is how the fake marriage becomes a real feeling, and what happens when the children learn the truth. The ending is taken as one of the best closes of a series in recent years.

16.plot: 在1958年的纽约，米琪麦瑟尔的生活很美好。她有丈夫和孩子，在他们的上西区公寓享受美好的赎罪日晚餐。但是当她的生活出乎意料地转变方向时，她必须快速决定她还擅长什么。所有人都认为从家庭主妇到脱口秀喜剧演员是疯狂的选择，但她不这么想。
16.plotEn: It’s 1958 Manhattan and Miriam “Midge” Maisel has everything she’s ever wanted - the perfect husband, kids, and Upper West Side apartment. But when her life suddenly takes a turn and Midge must start over, she discovers a previously unknown talent - one that will take her all the way from the comedy clubs of Greenwich Village to a spot on Johnny Carson’s couch.

17.plot: 在生育率崩溃后的基列国，能生育的女性被编为使女，分配给权贵家庭。琼以奥芙弗雷德的名字生活，记住自己原来叫什么成了一种反抗。
17.plotEn: In Gilead, after fertility collapses, women who can bear children are made Handmaids and assigned to the households of the powerful. June lives under the name Offred. Remembering what she used to be called becomes a form of resistance.
17.playbill: 改编自阿特伍德的小说：美国被极权宗教政权取代，有生育能力的女性被分配到高官家里生孩子。第一季压抑而精准，让 Hulu 成为第一个拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集的流媒体平台。后几季越拍越长，评价有所下滑。
17.playbillEn: Adapted from Atwood’s novel. The United States is replaced by a religious authoritarian regime, and women who can have children are assigned to the houses of senior officials to bear them. The first season is oppressive and exact. It made Hulu the first streaming service to win the Emmy for best drama. The later seasons got longer, and the reception slipped.

19.plot: 维斯特洛的几个家族争夺铁王座，北境的长城外面还有一场被大多数人当成传说的冬天。改编自乔治·R·R·马丁的小说，贵族的联姻和战场用的是同一套规则。
19.plotEn: Several houses in Westeros contest the Iron Throne. Beyond the Wall in the north, a winter that most people treat as legend is also coming. Adapted from the novels of George R. R. Martin, the nobles’ marriages and the battles run on the same set of rules.
19.playbill: 奇幻外壳下是一部权谋剧。主角随时可能死掉，谁都不安全，这是前几季最抓人的地方。制作规模接近电影，《黑水之战》《私生子之战》都是剧集战争场面的标杆。最后一季口碑大跌，前六季仍然值得看。
19.playbillEn: Under the fantasy is a show about power. Lead characters can die at any time, and no one is safe. That is what made the early seasons grip. The scale of the production is close to a film. “Blackwater” and “The Battle of the Bastards” set a standard for war on television. The last season’s reputation collapsed. The first six are still worth watching.

20.plot: 故事发生在高科技产业云集的美国硅谷，在这里，最有资质成功的人往往却是最没有办法处理其“功成名就”的人，本剧主人公理查德（托马斯·米德勒蒂奇 Thomas Middleditch 饰）正是这样的人。故事围绕着包括理查德在内的四个不善社交但绝顶聪明的计算机程序员，以及早期依靠互联网站发家的百万富翁埃利希（托德·约瑟夫·米勒 T.J. Miller 饰）。理查德他们免费住在埃利希那个号称“孵化器”的别墅里，自行研究开发有潜力的科技项目。他们原以为理查德开发的“魔笛手”注定是个失败的产品，岂料其运用的新型压缩算法具有无穷的商业潜力，当即引起大公司“互利”的注意，要高价收购。正当理查德要同意时，另一家投资公司加入争夺，“魔笛手”一时间水涨船高，一场价值千万的争夺战开始了。
20.plotEn: In the high-tech gold rush of modern Silicon Valley, the people most qualified to succeed are the least capable of handling success. Partially inspired by Mike Judge’s own experiences as a Silicon Valley engineer in the late ‘80s, Silicon Valley is an American sitcom that centers around six programmers who are living together and trying to make it big in the Silicon Valley.

21.plot: 本剧的主角为艾略特·奥尔德森 (Elliot Alderson)，他居住在纽约市，是一名网络安全工程师。晚上，他化身为一名黑客。艾略特患有社交恐惧症。艾略特遇见了一个神秘的无政府主义者，他名为机器人先生 (Mr. Robot) 。机器人先生招募艾略特加入他的黑客组织“反社会 (fsociety)”。艾略特感到好奇，但他并没有确定是否要加入这个黑客组织。机器人先生让艾略特暗中摧毁雇佣艾略特的公司。艾略特对此跨国集团反感，但秉持良心公义，他不想伤害无辜，所以仍然一次又一次抗拒去彻底揭发对世界有巨大影响力的这个集团。
21.plotEn: A young programmer, Elliot, suffers from a debilitating anti-social disorder and decides that he can only connect to people by hacking them. He wields his skills as a weapon to protect the people that he cares about. Elliot finds himself in the intersection between a cybersecurity firm he works for and the underworld organizations that are recruiting him to bring down corporate America.

22.plot: 根据Aziz Ansari单元演员生活经历改编。纽约一名年届三十的演员Dev，连自己下一顿要吃什么都无法决定，更不用说接下来的人生路要如何抉择。故事将会探讨多样话题，从老年人困境到移民经历到如何寻找晚餐最好吃的意面。
22.plotEn: 30-year-old New York actor Dev takes on such pillars of maturity as the first big job, a serious relationship, and busting sex offenders on the subway.

25.plot: 高中化学老师沃尔特·怀特确诊肺癌，为了给家人留下钱，与前学生杰西合伙制造冰毒。一条房车里的生计，慢慢变成一座他不肯交出的帝国。
25.plotEn: Walter White, a high-school chemistry teacher, is diagnosed with lung cancer. To leave money for his family he partners with his former student Jesse and starts making meth. A living made in a trailer slowly becomes an empire he will not hand over.
25.playbill: 看一个普通人怎样一步步变成毒枭，每次转变都有前因，不是突然黑化。克兰斯顿凭这个角色拿了四座艾美剧情类男主角。前两季稍慢，越往后越紧；第五季的《奥兹曼迪亚斯》常被评为美剧史上最好的单集之一。
25.playbillEn: You watch an ordinary man become a drug lord, and each turn has a cause. He does not simply go bad. Cranston won four Emmys for best actor in a drama for the role. The first two seasons are a little slow, and it tightens after that. “Ozymandias,” in the fifth season, is often called one of the best single episodes in American television.

26.plot: 一名养尊处优的纽约人因一桩旧案锒铛入狱，她很快就在女子监狱中结交了朋友，也树立了敌人。
26.plotEn: A crime she committed in her youthful past sends Piper Chapman to a women's prison, where she trades her comfortable New York life for one of unexpected camaraderie and conflict in an eccentric group of fellow inmates.

28.plot: 物理学家莱纳德和谢尔顿与同事霍华德、拉杰一起生活、工作。邻居佩妮的出现，让这群天才科学家原本封闭的生活逐渐发生改变。
28.plotEn: Physicists Leonard and Sheldon find their nerd-centric social circle with pals Howard and Raj expanding when aspiring actress Penny moves in next door.

29.plot: 中情局军官嘉莉·马蒂森认定，被救回来的海军陆战队员布罗迪已经倒向敌人。她的判断力极强，也受躁郁症左右，局里没有人愿意完全相信她。
29.plotEn: The CIA officer Carrie Mathison becomes convinced that Brody, a Marine who has been brought home, has turned. Her judgment is extremely sharp, and it is also steered by bipolar disorder. No one at the agency is willing to believe her completely.
29.playbill: 一名被俘多年的美军士兵归国，中情局女特工嘉莉怀疑他已被策反。第一季把「他到底是不是」的悬念吊得非常好。克莱尔·丹妮丝演的嘉莉既有天才般的判断力，也受双相障碍困扰，是全剧的核心。
29.playbillEn: A Marine comes home after years in captivity, and the CIA officer Carrie suspects he has been turned. The first season holds the question “is he or isn’t he” very well. Claire Danes’s Carrie has a near-genius judgment and is also living with bipolar disorder. She is the center of the show.

30.plot: 被取消律师资格的杰夫·温格进入一所社区大学，凑出了一个什么课都一起上的学习小组。剧经常整集改成另一种类型：动作片、纪录片、八比特游戏。
30.plotEn: Jeff Winger, disbarred, enrolls at a community college and assembles a study group that takes every class together. The show will spend a whole episode as another genre: an action movie, a documentary, an 8-bit game.
30.playbill: 一群背景各异的人在社区大学组成学习小组。它常常整集戏仿各种类型片，比如彩弹枪大战、黑帮片和纪录片。第二、三季最强；后期主创被解雇又回归，质量起伏较大。
30.playbillEn: A group of people with nothing in common form a study group at a community college. Whole episodes parody a genre: paintball, a gangster film, a documentary. Seasons two and three are the strongest. The creator was later fired and then brought back, and the quality swings.

31.plot: 1960 年代的麦迪逊大道，创意总监唐·德雷珀替客户发明欲望，自己则靠一个偷来的名字过活。办公室里的性别、酒和晋升，比广告本身更忙。
31.plotEn: On Madison Avenue in the 1960s, the creative director Don Draper invents desires for clients and lives under a name he stole. Gender, drink, and promotion in the office are busier than the advertising.
31.playbill: 1960 年代的纽约广告业，西装、烟酒和办公室政治都拍得极讲究。主线是唐·德雷珀的身份之谜，佩吉从秘书升为文案的那条线同样好看，十年的社会变化都藏在背景里。节奏慢，适合细看；连续四年拿下艾美最佳剧情类剧集。
31.playbillEn: New York advertising in the 1960s. The suits, the cigarettes, the drinks, and the office politics are all made with great care. The main line is the mystery of Don Draper’s identity. Peggy’s rise from secretary to copywriter is just as good to watch, and a decade of social change sits in the background. It is slow, and it rewards attention. It won the Emmy for best drama four years running.

32.plot: 普里切特一家三支，以假纪录片的方式过同一座城市里的日子：再婚、同志伴侣和传统郊区家庭，麻烦都出在晚饭之前。
32.plotEn: Three branches of the Pritchett family get through their days in the same city, shot as a fake documentary: a second marriage, a same-sex couple, and a conventional suburban family. The trouble all arrives before dinner.
32.playbill: 伪纪录片形式拍三个有亲戚关系的家庭：老夫少妻、同性伴侣和普通的三口之家。每集半小时，笑点稳定，很适合全家一起看。连续五年拿下艾美最佳喜剧剧集。
32.playbillEn: A mockumentary of three related households: an older man with a younger wife, a same-sex couple, and an ordinary family of three. Half an hour an episode, the jokes are steady, and it is easy to watch together. It won the Emmy for best comedy five years in a row.
